Name: Express Smoothie
Author: Soid64
Description:
"This is my first Mod I hope you like it" New update compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6, now in ContentPatcher with
ExtraMachineConfig and CustomBush.

Adds a smoothie and milkshake maker that works with any fruit from the game or from other mods. Also adds a Creole or Latin lemon bush and a moriche fruit tree as well as the fabulous papelón with lemon.

[b]Adds[/b]
[list]
[*]Fruit Smoothies
[*]Fruit Milkshake
[*]3 in 1 smoothie
[*]Paperón with lemon juice 
[/list]A blender that will give you the Alex recipe with 5 hearts

[b]Installation[/b]:
Install Smapi, ContentPatcher, MailFrameworkMod, ExtraMachineConfig and CustomBush
Then unzip and copy the Express Smoothie folder to the mods folder.

[b]Uninstall[/b]:
just delete the Express Smoothie folder
Recommendation in saved games sell or download all the products obtained before uninstalling the mod.

I hope you like it, I apologize for the translation I only speak Spanish.,

To learn more visit my Github
